content:
#1 Hello everyone,

This is my first post on nLab, I wanted to share the dark theme I’ve made for nLab.

I’ve seen other dark themes for the website, but mine is a bit more opinionated. Here are the features:

  • Dark theme and brighter colors
  • Changed link colors and removed underlines
  • Mobile friendly with scrollers on wider formuals or images
  • Search bar and header redesign for mobile as well
  • Inverse color and merge images with the page background
  • Titles redesign
  • Large articles width
  • Changed the margins between paragraphs to remove the spacing when followed with a list or an image
  • Changed quotes/images/questions/defintions/etc. styles
  • Other random tweaks

I hope some of you will appreciate it :)

Btw, the mobile-friendly tweaks could be applied to the current light-themed website and I’d appreciate feedback on the other tweaks
subject: Complete mobile-friendly dark redesign of nLab
